briefdescription.para: Obtain a supplier for the specified Resource.

parameterdescription.para: the Resource that is required for dependency injection

simplesect.para: a supplier Function, or null if that Resource cannot be supplied

briefdescription.para: Obtain the value of the specified Resource.

detaileddescription.para: Some Resources have a single value, such as a constant value or a singleton service. Other Resources may provide a different value each time it is requested.

simplesect.para: the value of the specified Resource, or null

briefdescription.para: This method is called by the JitConnector via reflection.
